**Finding: MISSING** (medium severity, transition category)

**What I checked:**
- Section 13 (Term) and Section 14 (Termination) — p0078/p0079: these only run services to month-end after Client's notice and place the burden on *Client* to arrange a new name server (30 days) and new hosting environment (60 days). Nothing requires TrueLink to help or hand anything back.
- Section 10 (Confidentiality) — no return-or-destroy obligation at all, so not even a partial substitute (contrary to the planner hint).
- Full-text searches for return / export / transition / migration / delete turned up nothing relevant.

This matters because TrueLink hosts Client Content and, per Section 10(c), "borrower and loan data" — exactly the material we'd need back on exit.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new Section 14a inserted after p0079, at the preferred position — up to 6 months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Client Content/data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. It will survive termination under Section 24 (Sections 1 and 5–30 survive).

**Negotiation note:** the comment flags the fallback (90 days' assistance) as available if Vendor pushes back on the six-month tail, provided the 30-day export and deletion certification hold.
